name: ai-knowhow
description: Know how it was built. Know what to build it with. Two open-source agent skills: modelwise (right model, effort and prompt for any task) and retrace (turn finished AI work into lessons that teach people).

plugins.name: modelwise
plugins.description: For any department and industry: decide like the top practitioner, then pick the right Anthropic/OpenAI model and effort for each phase and write model-specific prompts, with cost comparisons.

plugins.name: retrace
plugins.description: Retrace a finished AI-assisted task and teach it on the spot: the moves the AI made and why, the turning points, the prompts, the mistakes and the cheaper path, saved as a reusable lesson skill.
